criteria.title: Spatial orbit and bay copy with spatial loads
requireTestIds: M03 copy portal into bays, analyse and inspect My Mz torsion
3D exposes Y direction and reference grid; orbit updates compass without model changes
criteria.observation: CopyBay plus spatial roof loads produce non-trivial My/Mz/T; orbit compass updates without model hash change.

criteria.title: Separate model/analysis Workers and cancel
requireTestIds: M03 dual Workers: cancel leaves model intact; superseded solve stays stale
criteria.observation: Cancel restores the model within timing gates; a superseded solve never becomes Current after edits.

criteria.title: Skewed/asymmetric OpenSees pack + native R01/B09
criteria.observation: S01/S02/B07 match OpenSees; R01/B09 are native analytical cross-checks (ADR 0006).

criteria.title: 5,000-node multibay solve and memory guard
criteria.observation: Connected 5k-node frame solves under the median gate; WASM refuses over-budget models with MEMORY_LIMIT.

criteria.title: All-axis unit-action tests
criteria.observation: Tip unit loads recover tip end actions with root lever balance and section@0 = −q_i.

criteria.title: Member reversal and roll
criteria.observation: Endpoint reversal and localY roll swap My/Mz with tip uz scaling by Iy/Iz.

criteria.title: Section-axis editing
requireTestIds: M03 section-axis: edit localY roll swaps My/Mz end actions
criteria.observation: Property-form localY edit re-analyses with swapped end moments in the forces table.

criteria.title: Physical-to-analytical mapping UI
requireTestIds: M03 hierarchy: split shows physical parent and analytical children
criteria.observation: Split children group under physical parent in the model tree with inspector lineage.

criteria.title: GPU loss during analysis preserves model
criteria.observation: Recreating the viewport while analysis is blocked keeps the model hash and entity counts.

criteria.title: Analyse does not block UI >100 ms
criteria.observation: Event-loop gaps stay ≤100 ms after Analyse while the Worker is busy.

limitations: Fail-closed parent recorder; OpenSees scope per ADR 0006; WASM memory smoke separate from 5k CLI capacity.
